description:
Set up a nonprofit organization on Kindora from a brief you wrote about it.

Read https://www.kindora.co/agents first: it says how to build the brief (organization name,
website or EIN, mission, programs, funding, the person's name and role) and to show it to the
person before sending. Pass the approved brief as `brief`, the person's work email as `email`,
and `locale` ("en" or "es"). Kindora emails the person a link; this tool returns no link. The
person confirms their email with a six-digit code, reviews the profile, and opens the workspace.
name: start_kindora_profile
title: Start Kindora Profile
